description: Minimal project-independent Jacobi-symbol and quadratic-reciprocity authority set.

items.statement: For every positive odd integer n and all integers a and b, the Jacobi symbol is multiplicative in the numerator: (ab/n) = (a/n)(b/n).
conditions: n is a positive odd integer
Jacobi symbols use the standard prime-factor definition

provenance.review_policy: Exact statement reviewed and frozen in the versioned Math Research Agent foundation registry

items.statement: For every positive odd integer n, the Jacobi supplementary law is (-1/n) = (-1)^((n-1)/2).
conditions: n is a positive odd integer
Jacobi symbols use the standard prime-factor definition

provenance.canonical_name: First supplementary law for the Jacobi symbol

items.statement: For distinct odd primes p and q, (p/q)(q/p) = (-1)^(((p-1)/2)((q-1)/2)), where each parenthesized quotient is a Legendre symbol.
conditions: p and q are distinct odd primes
Legendre symbols use the standard quadratic-residue definition

provenance.review_policy: Exact statement reviewed and frozen in the versioned Math Research Agent foundation registry

items.statement: For every positive odd integer n with gcd(n,5)=1, (5/n) = (n/5), with Jacobi symbol on the left and the standard residue character modulo 5 on the right.
conditions: n is a positive odd integer
Jacobi and Legendre symbols use their standard definitions
